{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Preserve existing Spring XD module contracts and public APIs unless a requirement explicitly requires a change.",
    "Migrate the project-reactor-based gpfdist sink into the core module set, adapting package names, build metadata, configuration, and tests as needed.",
    "Implement the centralized module registry using a configurable GitHub repository, branch, and credentials, with uploads committed through the GitHub API and registry reads using repository contents.",
    "Use a repeatable RabbitMQ benchmark harness on Rackspace with configurable container-node counts, message rates, payload sizes, and collection of throughput, latency, and resource metrics.",
    "Extend Flo parser endpoints with structured, consistent error responses while retaining compatibility for successful responses.",
    "Expose JavaMail properties through the existing adapter configuration so IMAP/SMTP SSL and TLS settings can be supplied without hard-coded provider-specific behavior.",
    "Use HDFS as the default custom-module registry location while retaining configuration override support, and remove custom-modules.zip from the YARN distribution packaging.",
    "Add shell startup initialization support that automatically loads a conventional init file when present, while retaining the existing explicit script command.",
    "Implement graceful stream undeployment by stopping message intake, allowing in-flight messages to drain through the flow, applying a configurable timeout, and then forcing shutdown if necessary.",
    "Add unit, integration, regression, and packaging tests for each changed subsystem, using mocks or embedded services where practical."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The existing Spring XD codebase, build, CI environment, and test infrastructure are available and buildable with Java 17-compatible tooling.",
    "The increment covers all eight user stories and includes production-quality implementation, automated tests, documentation, and packaging updates.",
    "Existing gpfdist functionality is sufficiently mature to migrate; no new GPDB or HAWQ protocol features are required.",
    "GitHub repository access, credentials, repository layout, and branch policy can be configured through existing application configuration mechanisms; enterprise SSO or a new credential-management system is out of scope.",
    "The RabbitMQ benchmark requires preparing scripts and documenting results, but not building a permanent performance-testing platform or executing a long-term capacity study.",
    "Rackspace infrastructure and required RabbitMQ, XD container, and monitoring access are available without procurement or infrastructure-team lead time.",
    "Flo parser endpoint requirements do not define exact error schemas, so a versioned structured error format with stable error codes, messages, and location details will be introduced.",
    "JavaMail dependencies already exist or can be upgraded within the supported dependency range; certificate authority provisioning and mail-server administration are out of scope.",
    "HDFS is available in supported deployments and the existing custom-module registry abstraction can be configured to use it without redesigning module storage.",
    "The shell can discover its installation and configuration directories using existing conventions; no new service-discovery protocol is required.",
    "Graceful shutdown applies to supported Spring Integration stream components and provides a timeout-based best-effort drain rather than guaranteeing completion for externally blocked operations.",
    "Effort is for one developer and includes coding, code review preparation, debugging, and local/CI test execution, but excludes elapsed waiting time for external approvals or infrastructure provisioning."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Repository analysis and implementation planning",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the existing module, registry, shell, Flo, mail, stream lifecycle, build, deployment, and test structures; identify affected APIs and prepare the implementation plan.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Migrate gpfdist project-reactor sink to core",
      "activity_description": "Move the gpfdist module from the spring-xd-modules repository into the core repository, update build and dependency metadata, adapt namespaces and configuration, preserve project-reactor behavior, and add migration compatibility where required.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "Implement centralized GitHub module registry",
      "activity_description": "Implement repository-backed module registry access and upload behavior, including configurable repository and branch settings, GitHub authentication, repository content operations, commit handling, synchronization behavior, and failure reporting.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "RabbitMQ Rackspace benchmark implementation",
      "activity_description": "Prepare repeatable deployment and benchmark scripts for RabbitMQ and multiple XD container nodes, define workload and scaling measurements, collect throughput, latency, and resource data, and document benchmark results and limitations.",
      "most_likely_effort": 7
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "Flo parser endpoint error-reporting improvements",
      "activity_description": "Refactor parser endpoint validation and exception handling, define consistent structured error responses and codes, preserve successful endpoint behavior, and add endpoint and parser regression coverage.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Secure IMAP and SMTP mail configuration",
      "activity_description": "Support passing JavaMail SSL/TLS and related provider properties through Mail source configuration, validate configuration wiring for IMAP and SMTP, and add secure-connection and backward-compatibility tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "HDFS default custom-module registry and YARN packaging change",
      "activity_description": "Change the default custom-module remote location to HDFS, verify shell and REST upload paths, update defaults and deployment documentation, remove custom-modules.zip from YARN artifacts, and update packaging tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Automatic shell environment initialization",
      "activity_description": "Add automatic discovery and execution of the shell initialization file, support the documented admin and Hadoop configuration commands, handle missing or invalid files safely, and add shell startup and script execution tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "Graceful stream undeployment",
      "activity_description": "Implement coordinated stream stop behavior that prevents new intake, drains in-flight messages through the sink, supports a configurable shutdown timeout, reports forced termination, and covers archive-extraction and dead-letter-queue scenarios.",
      "most_likely_effort": 12
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-feature automated testing",
      "activity_description": "Add or extend unit, integration, component, and regression tests across module migration, GitHub and HDFS registries, mail security, Flo errors, shell initialization, graceful shutdown, and packaging behavior.",
      "most_likely_effort": 12
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Documentation, configuration, and upgrade guidance",
      "activity_description": "Document new configuration properties, GitHub credentials and repository setup, HDFS defaults, secure mail examples, shell initialization, graceful shutdown semantics, benchmark execution, and upgrade or migration considerations.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A12",
      "activity_name": "End-to-end verification and release integration",
      "activity_description": "Run the complete build and CI-quality verification, resolve integration failures, validate distribution artifacts, review backward compatibility, and prepare the final change set for release.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 92
  }
}

technical_and_design_decisions: Preserve existing Spring XD module contracts and public APIs unless a requirement explicitly requires a change.
Migrate the project-reactor-based gpfdist sink into the core module set, adapting package names, build metadata, configuration, and tests as needed.
Implement the centralized module registry using a configurable GitHub repository, branch, and credentials, with uploads committed through the GitHub API and registry reads using repository contents.
Use a repeatable RabbitMQ benchmark harness on Rackspace with configurable container-node counts, message rates, payload sizes, and collection of throughput, latency, and resource metrics.
Extend Flo parser endpoints with structured, consistent error responses while retaining compatibility for successful responses.
Expose JavaMail properties through the existing adapter configuration so IMAP/SMTP SSL and TLS settings can be supplied without hard-coded provider-specific behavior.
Use HDFS as the default custom-module registry location while retaining configuration override support, and remove custom-modules.zip from the YARN distribution packaging.
Add shell startup initialization support that automatically loads a conventional init file when present, while retaining the existing explicit script command.
Implement graceful stream undeployment by stopping message intake, allowing in-flight messages to drain through the flow, applying a configurable timeout, and then forcing shutdown if necessary.
Add unit, integration, regression, and packaging tests for each changed subsystem, using mocks or embedded services where practical.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD codebase, build, CI environment, and test infrastructure are available and buildable with Java 17-compatible tooling.
The increment covers all eight user stories and includes production-quality implementation, automated tests, documentation, and packaging updates.
Existing gpfdist functionality is sufficiently mature to migrate; no new GPDB or HAWQ protocol features are required.

GitHub repository access, credentials, repository layout, and branch policy can be configured through existing application configuration mechanisms; enterprise SSO or a new credential-management system is out of scope.
The RabbitMQ benchmark requires preparing scripts and documenting results, but not building a permanent performance-testing platform or executing a long-term capacity study.
Rackspace infrastructure and required RabbitMQ, XD container, and monitoring access are available without procurement or infrastructure-team lead time.
Flo parser endpoint requirements do not define exact error schemas, so a versioned structured error format with stable error codes, messages, and location details will be introduced.
JavaMail dependencies already exist or can be upgraded within the supported dependency range; certificate authority provisioning and mail-server administration are out of scope.
HDFS is available in supported deployments and the existing custom-module registry abstraction can be configured to use it without redesigning module storage.
The shell can discover its installation and configuration directories using existing conventions; no new service-discovery protocol is required.
Graceful shutdown applies to supported Spring Integration stream components and provides a timeout-based best-effort drain rather than guaranteeing completion for externally blocked operations.

Effort is for one developer and includes coding, code review preparation, debugging, and local/CI test execution, but excludes elapsed waiting time for external approvals or infrastructure provisioning.

activities.activity_description: Move the gpfdist module from the spring-xd-modules repository into the core repository, update build and dependency metadata, adapt namespaces and configuration, preserve project-reactor behavior, and add migration compatibility where required.

Implement repository-backed module registry access and upload behavior, including configurable repository and branch settings, GitHub authentication, repository content operations, commit handling, synchronization behavior, and failure reporting.

Prepare repeatable deployment and benchmark scripts for RabbitMQ and multiple XD container nodes, define workload and scaling measurements, collect throughput, latency, and resource data, and document benchmark results and limitations.

Refactor parser endpoint validation and exception handling, define consistent structured error responses and codes, preserve successful endpoint behavior, and add endpoint and parser regression coverage.

activities.activity_name: Secure IMAP and SMTP mail configuration
activities.activity_description: Support passing JavaMail SSL/TLS and related provider properties through Mail source configuration, validate configuration wiring for IMAP and SMTP, and add secure-connection and backward-compatibility tests.

activities.activity_name: HDFS default custom-module registry and YARN packaging change
activities.activity_description: Change the default custom-module remote location to HDFS, verify shell and REST upload paths, update defaults and deployment documentation, remove custom-modules.zip from YARN artifacts, and update packaging tests.

Add automatic discovery and execution of the shell initialization file, support the documented admin and Hadoop configuration commands, handle missing or invalid files safely, and add shell startup and script execution tests.

Implement coordinated stream stop behavior that prevents new intake, drains in-flight messages through the sink, supports a configurable shutdown timeout, reports forced termination, and covers archive-extraction and dead-letter-queue scenarios.

Add or extend unit, integration, component, and regression tests across module migration, GitHub and HDFS registries, mail security, Flo errors, shell initialization, graceful shutdown, and packaging behavior.

Document new configuration properties, GitHub credentials and repository setup, HDFS defaults, secure mail examples, shell initialization, graceful shutdown semantics, benchmark execution, and upgrade or migration considerations.
Run the complete build and CI-quality verification, resolve integration failures, validate distribution artifacts, review backward compatibility, and prepare the final change set for release.
